subject: Migration: Deployment mode selection (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@orion-analytics.com>, Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@orion-analytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Migration: Deployment mode selection (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Hi Samantha / Carlos

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and suggested next steps so we have a clean mutual action plan.

Key points you shared:
- Primary driver: reduce per-token cost and improve tail latency for interactive analytics queries (p95 target ~100-150ms).
- Current environment: self-hosted cluster (NVIDIA A100s) running custom fine-tuned HF models; significant ops burden and slow scaling for spikes.
- Data sensitivity: customer PII/analytics data; prefer US-only residency and strong auditability (SOC 2 evidence requested).
- Migration goals: replace the legacy GPU cluster for model serving while retaining control over model versions and fine-tuning artifacts.

Deployment modes we discussed (tradeoffs):
- Hosted API: fastest to go-live, simple integration, limited control over private networking; good for proof-of-value.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput and lower unit costs - good middle-ground for high-throughput production workloads.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): full network isolation, KMS integration, best for regulated data but longer setup and higher OPEX.

Proposed next steps:
1) I attached our migration playbook (redwood_migration_playbook.pdf) - review and flag any gaps.
2) We'll draft an initial SOW + pricing for a Dedicated + VPC option and a Private on-prem pricing variant.
3) Tech deep-dive with Rishi (architecture + migration plan) - propose Tue 20 Jul 10:00 AM PT.
4) You mentioned legal/infosec will need SOC 2 artifacts - we'll attach those in the SOW package.

Can you confirm the proposed time for the architecture call and whether Legal should be on the SOW review?

Thanks - looking forward to getting you off the cluster and into a predictable, lower-cost serving model.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_migration_playbook.pdf (see summary & migration checklist)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@orion-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos.mendes@orion-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Migration: Deployment mode selection (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Hi Marissa

Appreciate the clear recap - that matches our notes. A few clarifications from our side before the architecture call:

- Residency: US-only is a hard requirement for now. Any Dedicated capacity or Private deployment must be US-region only.
- Model pinning/versioning: We need deterministic model version control and the ability to bring our own fine-tuned weights. Is that supported in your Dedicated offering?
- Spike handling: We have daily bursts tied to batch processing windows. Can you share typical autoscale latency for Dedicated pools (cold-start times, burst capacity behavior)?
- Compliance artifacts: SOC 2 Type II report and encryption-at-rest details are required for our procurement checklist - can you include a summary or link in the SOW?

Background on our stack: we run several HF-based llama-variant models fine-tuned on our internal corpora; current serving is via a home-grown wrapper around the A100 cluster. We're looking to avoid a forklift migration but want a clear rollback plan.

POC & timeline: Ideally pilot a single critical model in a Hosted or Dedicated configuration within 3-4 weeks, then decide on Private/VPC if needed for compliance.

If you can send the SOW/pricing and SOC 2 evidence ahead of the architecture call, that would help Legal move quickly.

Thanks - Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform Engineering | Orion Analytics
samantha.lee@orion-analytics.com

Attachment: orion_requirements.xlsx (internal requirements summary)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Migration: Deployment mode selection (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) - action items

Team - forwarding Samantha's reply and proposed next steps. Quick plan and owners: 

1) SOW & pricing (Laura) - please prepare two line-items: (A) Dedicated capacity + VPC configuration with committed throughput and burst band, (B) Private on-prem deployment (installation + annual support). Include expected TTM for each and a PO-friendly pricing table. Attach SOW-Orion-v1.docx when ready.
2) Technical migration plan (Rishi) - provide a short migration runbook: POC steps, rollback strategy, model import process (BYOW weights), and autoscale behavior for Dedicated pools. Also include estimated engineering effort and any infra prerequisites on Orion side.
3) Security pack (Laura/Rishi) - include SOC 2 summary and encryption details; I've attached our current SOC 2 package for quick reference (security-evidence-SOC2.zip).
4) Schedule: confirm 20 Jul 10:00 AM PT arch call - mark as tentative on HubSpot (link below).

Quote from Samantha's ask: "POC within 3-4 weeks, pilot a single critical model in Hosted or Dedicated then decide on Private/VPC for compliance."

Let me know if either of you foresee blockers. I'll send the calendar invite and include Orion's Legal if we have the SOW draft ready beforehand.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments: SOW-Orion-v1.docx, security-evidence-SOC2.zip
